name: autocar-os
description: AUTOCAR OS — ERP transport de voyageurs

scripts.build:hosting: node scripts/pull-hosting.mjs && node scripts/ensure-hosting-env.mjs && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 install && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @autocar/shared build && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @autocar/api exec prisma generate && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @autocar/api exec prisma db push && node scripts/seed-once.mjs && npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @autocar/api build && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=/api API_PROXY_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:4000 npx --yes pnpm@9.15.0 --filter @autocar/web build
scripts.start:hosting: node scripts/ensure-hosting-env.mjs && node scripts/ensure-hosting-build.mjs && node scripts/start-hosting.mjs
